summary: Compression concentrates on party chatter and incidental description while retaining the ash-valley imagery, Myrtle’s transformations, Nick’s divided spectatorship, and the fractured ending.
acceptable_changes: Myrtle’s sister and the photographer couple remain unnamed but retain locally identified roles.
Monte Carlo chatter, subsidiary anecdotes, and repeated commercial exchanges are omitted.
The Catholic lie and photographer’s bedroom scene survive despite the optional cuts because they preserve deception and narrative ambiguity.
risks: Condensed party dialogue reduces the duration and social texture of Nick’s intoxication.
review_focus: Check the pacing from Myrtle’s marriage account to the assault and the continuity of the unnamed photographer through the ending.
